description: This file defines the IStreamIdentity interface, which identifies a stream uniquely by providing a Guid and a Namespace property.

classes.name: IStreamIdentity
classes.description: An interface representing a unique identifier for a stream, including a Guid and a Namespace.

methods.name: Guid
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier (Guid) for the stream.

methods.name: Namespace
methods.description: Gets the namespace associated with the stream.
